# Current P35-R2 recovery / preview checkpoint — October 29, 2026

Status: **in_progress**. Owner explicitly requested R2 continuation. Delivered an independent R2 recovery/fixture/mobile slice; **R1 remains partial and R2 is not certified complete**. Both still block R3 configuration expansion. P36 was not started. This entry supersedes the older R2-not-started/retained-P34-preview statements below; other R1 results remain.

## Delivered behavior and boundaries

- Fixed a concrete data-loss cause in AuthRevalidator: background access revalidation no longer replaces the Outlet with a loading page. Existing forms stay mounted and inert while authority is checked. Account/term/guest identity or the canonical capability set changing resets all existing scoped draft providers and form trees. No private draft browser cache/storage was added. A pending check is not treated as an authorization success; actions remain paused until it resolves.
- EditSafety at the existing account-scoped boundary tracks only explicitly marked work edit surfaces, not ordinary filters. Work/task editors and requester metadata are covered. App navigation/back offers Keep editing or an explicit Discard edits and leave decision. Destructive work/detail/readiness reload controls obtain discard intent if entered work is present. Native document unload uses the browser's beforeunload protection; after an explicit full-document discard, memory is intentionally gone. Uncertain/busy task/deliverable commands are marked: app navigation cannot discard their retry key, and destructive reload is prevented. Existing exact-key commands and server checks are unchanged. Confirmations can conservatively appear after a confirmed save; remaining entered fields are not silently assumed saved.
- The account/term/capability reset is tested. **Record-specific scope revocation and every other editor's recovery path still need coverage/repair**; this slice does not claim all-surface safe recovery. Request/finance/readiness memory retains its preexisting command semantics; we did not replace P34 or business state engines.
- Added an opt-in synthetic adoption fixture using the existing real components and isolated PostgreSQL: enabled Tasks gateway; assigned personal first-work checklist for Fictional Morgan; existing head/deliverable; fictional primary River/backup Alex process contacts; real synthetic invitation creation/redemption and exact-record grant for an external guest. No hosted user/roster/policy is seeded. Member/head/guest links are clearly synthetic role scenarios, not real-user impersonation. Guest queries resolve the real isolated auth context, cannot read directory/member task, and preview guest byte requests are explicitly403 (never routed as a core subject).
- Guest entry is a direct explicitly shared deliverable. The general /shared index remains unconnected; no claim that a complete guest shared-work discovery UI was built. Core Resources direct help/practice and isolated API-free sandbox remain. Publishing tools stay separate.
- Fixed the320px More target by removing the narrowing mobile margins and retaining44px minimum widths. All five primary mobile controls meet44x44 in the compiled browser check with no overflow. Corrected mobile text identity spacing. No new logo, decorative redesign or dependencies.

## Delivered R1 behavior

- Deliverable detail leads with the authorized next action, owner, target and blocker/help. Work facts, outcome/criteria, editor/workflow, files and activity have deliberate native disclosure entry points. Task detail leads with owner/assignee/date and a conservative progress/help direction; its editor, scope/evidence, files and activity are deliberate sections. Closing a disclosure keeps mounted safe input values; it is not a fix for refresh/back/account loss.
- Shared Finance/Publicity panels use one presentation component. Only an authorized deliverable applicability projection plus a successful neutral no-current-case response can say Not required. Newer pending/current review results override an older not-required projection. Missing/failed checks say Unavailable, not Not required. Task types never infer FIN/MCD applicability. No private case titles/counts/links/amounts are added and no command authorization changes.
- Ready for acceptance? keeps actual gates, pending checks, errors and independently permitted acceptance controls visible. Technical work-type verification is grouped separately. Deliverable workflow submit button names its selected actual action; immutable evidence/version guards remain.
- Overview keeps its authorized action/owner/date lanes with shorter introduction. Request package hash and full activity are grouped separately; existing requester next-action/status/date distinctions remain. Resources has direct scoped Open my work / Find help / safe practice routes, with authorized publishing tools in their own disclosure. Guest links lead to shared work/account contacts and never read the core resource API or roster.
- Native summaries now receive the existing visible-focus treatment and new work disclosures meet44px height. This does not close the separate mobile More target finding.

Paths reuse existing features; shared review presentation is src/components/ReviewGate.tsx. No config_versions storage, publish_configuration, migration, dependency or generic permission editor was added.
